ece_pct_note: Computed from the same per-image export (10 equal-width confidence bins, 0-100%), using each image's actual derived confidence from backend/wind_math.py's Normal-CDF formula (not a measured softmax - see model_card.py's known_failure_modes). Much lower than v2's ~27%, though the two aren't measuring the same kind of confidence, so this shows the derived confidence tracks accuracy reasonably well - it isn't a direct apples-to-apples improvement over v2's ECE.
